typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		updt_opr_id_c as string,
		lgle_st_c as string,
		lgle_stat_c as string,
		bnk_aba_id_c as integer,
		lgle_sic_c as integer,
		time_c as string,
		trans_pgm_id_c as string,
		add_x as timestamp,
		add_opr_id_c as string,
		lgle_tefra_c as string,
		updt_x as timestamp,
		lgle_title_c as string,
		lgle_ss_id_c as string,
		lgle_eff_x as timestamp,
		func_id_c as string,
		lgle_tax_id_c as string,
		lgle_middle_n as string,
		lgle_n_c as string,
		lgle_first_n as string,
		lgle_id_c as integer,
		lgle_type_c as string,
		lgle_last_n as string,
		lgle_full_n as string,
		lgle_end_x as timestamp,
		lgle_inst_n as string,
		IRSName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		updt_opr_id_c as string,
		lgle_st_c as string,
		lgle_stat_c as string,
		bnk_aba_id_c as string,
		lgle_sic_c as string,
		time_c as string,
		trans_pgm_id_c as string,
		add_x as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		add_opr_id_c as string,
		lgle_tefra_c as string,
		updt_x as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		lgle_title_c as string,
		lgle_ss_id_c as string,
		lgle_eff_x as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		func_id_c as string,
		lgle_tax_id_c as string,
		lgle_middle_n as string,
		lgle_n_c as string,
		lgle_first_n as string,
		lgle_id_c as string,
		lgle_type_c as string,
		lgle_last_n as string,
		lgle_full_n as string,
		lgle_end_x as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		lgle_inst_n as string,
		IRSName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		updt_opr_id_c,
		lgle_st_c,
		lgle_stat_c,
		bnk_aba_id_c,
		lgle_sic_c,
		time_c,
		trans_pgm_id_c,
		add_x,
		add_opr_id_c,
		lgle_tefra_c,
		updt_x,
		lgle_title_c,
		lgle_ss_id_c,
		lgle_eff_x,
		func_id_c,
		lgle_tax_id_c,
		lgle_middle_n,
		lgle_n_c,
		lgle_first_n,
		lgle_id_c,
		lgle_type_c,
		lgle_last_n,
		lgle_full_n,
		lgle_end_x,
		lgle_inst_n,
		IRSName),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
